verdict.rationale: Gazebo ships ready-made simulated sensors that generate data, optionally with noise, from cameras, laser range finders (lidar), IMU, GPS and more (gazebo-gh-14). That data is published over gz-transport pub/sub (gazebo-docs-36), and ros_gz connects Gazebo to a ROS installation (gazebo-docs-18, gazebo-docs-43). However, these are simulated sensor plugins, not drivers for physical hardware bring-up, and the evidence never names the message types or says they are standard. missing for 10: drivers for real camera/lidar/IMU/GPS hardware, documentation of standard message types for these sensors, per-sensor configuration docs, hands-on corroboration.
